item.title: Air Guitar Dreams, Real Guitar Life
item.description: He spent decades as an “expert” on air guitar, shredding on a tennis racket and dreaming of the real thing. But life, excuses, and hesitation kept him from ever starting—until his son’s guitar called to him one day.

item.title: My Empire of Dirt
item.description: When he gets the call that his grandma is entering hospice, a college student faces the impossible: grief, distance, and finals week. What follows is a quiet night, a beat-up guitar, and a moment of clarity that turns sorrow into strength.

item.title: The Guitar Under the Stairs
item.description: When Tony’s dad pulled an old guitar from under the stairs, he couldn’t have known it would spark three generations of music. This is the story of where it all began—and how one dusty instrument changed everything.

item.title: 41 Guitars He Never Played
item.description: He thought he was just helping his father-in-law sell a collection. Instead, he uncovered a passion and a part of himself he didn’t know was waiting.

item.title: The Guitar Lady in the Bleachers
item.description: When back pain stole her mobility and upended her life, Julie searched for something—anything—to keep her spirit alive. What she found in guitar wasn’t just music. It was healing, identity, and a way to stay in tune through life’s hardest seasons.

item.title: The Hummingbird Returns
item.description: A song on a porch sparked a lifelong love of guitar for a young girl in North Philadelphia. Decades later, that same song would echo through a three-generation jam on a Jersey Shore porch—proof that music never stops finding its way home.

item.title: When I Finally Said: “It’s Time”
item.description: When Jon’s grandfather passed down his 1959 Gibson, it wasn’t just a guitar—it was an invitation to finally learn guitar.

item.title: How Guitar Saved Us Both
item.description: A childhood guitar, long buried in memory, became the lifeline Nancy never expected—and the bridge that now connects her to her 12-year-old granddaughter. What began as comfort through life’s hardest chapters has grown into a shared musical world neither of them could have imagined.

item.title: The Traveling Gibson
item.description: A duct-taped Gibson. A Coast Guard childhood. A father, a daughter, and a guitar that refused to stop traveling. This Guitar Story is about how music becomes home—no matter how many times life asks you to move on.
